metadata.title: Seven cosmic condition dossiers: development, consciousness, agencies and transitions
metadata.source_method: Checked English original source passages in GA 13 chapters IV and VI, GA 11 chapter XIII, GA 104 tenth lecture; passage cues accompany every claim. Not a full corpus or German-language audit.
metadata.notice: Steiner's spiritual-cosmological claims and future projections, not empirically validated science or history.

source_register.citation_name: GA 13, Occult Science — An Outline, chapter IV, "The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man."
source_register.notes: Authored book, foundational planetary sequence, hierarchy roles, early Earth, Lemuria, Atlantis, Golgotha.

source_register.citation_name: GA 13, chapter VI, "Present and Future Evolution of the World and of Mankind."
source_register.notes: Authored book, future cultural periods, Moon and Sun reunification, Jupiter/Venus/Vulcan.

source_register.citation_name: GA 11, chapter XIII, "The Earth and Its Future."

source_register.notes: Nested sevenfold chronology and seven cultural periods.

conditions.label: Old Saturn
conditions.summary: An original warmth condition in Steiner's account, establishing the first physical-body germ while the hierarchies themselves undergo development. It is neither the astronomical planet Saturn nor a modern material body.
conditions.consciousness: Dim, trance-like consciousness, compared to the consciousness of minerals; not a waking human self.
conditions.human_organization: Physical-body germ, without the separately incorporated human etheric, astral or I organizations. A Spirit-Man germ is mentioned, but not a completed higher human faculty.
conditions.elements: Warmth rather than current gas, water or solid mineral matter; Steiner separates a 'physical body' governed by physical laws from a contemporary mineralized body.
agencies: Spirits of Will / Thrones: primal outpouring and later shaping
Spirits of Wisdom: reflected life, not a fully independent human life-body
Spirits of Movement and Spirits of Form: reflected feeling and differentiated forms
Spirits of Personality / Archai: their 'human' phase
Fire Spirits / Archangels and Seraphim: first sense-organ germs and assisting consciousness

milestones.heading: The physical germ is not current flesh
milestones.finding: Steiner distinguishes the warmth-based physical body from the mineralized human organism of the Earth.

milestones.heading: Higher beings work together
milestones.finding: Reflections of life, feeling and outward personality appear through several cooperating ranks; the activities are not exclusive to one epoch.

milestones.heading: The first sensory germs
milestones.finding: The Fire Spirits are associated with first sense-organ archetypes, in conjunction with Seraphim; these are not fully formed organs.

milestones.heading: Time becomes manifest
milestones.finding: In Steiner's distinction, 'Duration' precedes manifest Time; language of earlier-before is analogical.

milestones.heading: Germ of Spirit-Man
milestones.finding: A very early Spirit-Man seed is connected to Saturn, not the achieved future transformation by the I.

milestones.heading: Preservation through world-rest
milestones.finding: The Saturn seed is dissolved as manifestation yet carried forward and reworked after cosmic rest.

cautions: Do not identify Old Saturn with the current astronomical body.
A 'physical' germ does not mean tissue, chemistry or a fully formed skeleton.
Hierarchy roles overlap; avoid a single exclusive creator per organ.

conditions.label: Old Sun
conditions.summary: The previous physical germ is recapitulated and permeated by an etheric or life-body; warmth condenses toward a gas-like element, and the outward conditions of light and plant-like activity appear.
conditions.consciousness: Consciousness analogous to dreamless sleep or the contemporary plant state, not ordinary self-consciousness.
conditions.human_organization: Physical body advances to a second stage; the etheric life-body first becomes an enduring independent principle. Later germinal sensory and glandular differentiation is described.
conditions.elements: Warmth and air/gas, with the emergence of light; not the physical solar body familiar from astronomy.
agencies: Spirits of Wisdom / Kyriotetes: pouring forth the life-body
Spirits of Movement: motions within the living organization
Spirits of Form: stabilization of forms
Spirits of Personality and Seraphim: etheric activity and beginnings of reproduction
Fire Spirits / Archangels: work on inherited Saturn basis and sensory germs
Sons of Life / Angels and Cherubim: later life processes

milestones.heading: Not a fresh creation from nothing
milestones.finding: Sun begins with a transformed repetition of Old Saturn and continues its acquired potential.

milestones.heading: A differentiated life-body
milestones.finding: Wisdom beings endow the germ with etheric life; physical and life-body are described as differentiating while remaining interpenetrated.

milestones.heading: From warmth toward gas
milestones.finding: Sun is described through air/gaseous structures and plant-like flowing rather than today's plants.

milestones.heading: Different roles in sense and glandular origins
milestones.finding: The Archangels affect sense-organ precursors; the Spirits of Personality in union with Seraphim are linked to glandular beginnings.

milestones.heading: A new Saturn-like sphere
milestones.finding: Steiner relates lagging Personality spirits to a separated secondary heavenly body; this is a stage-specific esoteric account.

milestones.heading: World-rest follows Sun
milestones.finding: The results are carried through a rest before the Old Moon metamorphosis.

cautions: Do not treat etheric as a confirmed scientific or medical substance.
The source refers to precursors of glandular organs rather than present-day glands already functioning.

conditions.label: Old Moon
conditions.summary: The already formed physical and etheric organizations undergo a further metamorphosis through the incorporation of the astral body, giving the human ancestor feeling and picture consciousness.
conditions.consciousness: Dreamlike imaginative/picture consciousness, associated with the environment rather than waking objective cognition.
conditions.human_organization: Astral organization is added; sentient and intellectual soul beginnings are described as seeds rather than complete terrestrial faculties.
conditions.elements: Warmth and gas plus a liquid/water-like element; not yet the contemporary solid mineral form.
agencies: Spirits of Movement: astral incorporation and sensing
Spirits of Form: emerging wish, craving and stable tendencies
Spiritual Sun beings: influence on the separated Moon sphere
Spirits of Wisdom: later wisdom-giving work
Sons of Life / Angels: their 'human' stage within the Moon account

milestones.heading: Repetition precedes the new stage
milestones.finding: Old Moon restages Saturn and Sun conditions in altered form before the astral principle is incorporated.

milestones.heading: Astral body and impulse
milestones.finding: Movement produces sentient soul qualities; Form works upon unstable sympathy and antipathy to give rise to primitive desire.

milestones.heading: Condensation into a watery condition
milestones.finding: Steiner characterizes the body's three conditions as water-like, gaseous and warmth forms.

milestones.heading: The Sun–Moon relationship
milestones.finding: Separation permits differentiated spiritual influence, later alternating relationships and a concluding reunion.

milestones.heading: Picture awareness
milestones.finding: The Moon's dream-images correspond in Steiner's description to supersensible surroundings, unlike an individual's ordinary modern dream fragments.

milestones.heading: Sowing seeds of human soul-members
milestones.finding: The late Old Moon description connects the Sons of Life to the beginnings of sentient and intellectual soul; the free terrestrial I is still future.

cautions: Old Moon must not be conflated with Earth's current satellite.
The source's plant-mineral/animal-man terms are analogical esoteric classifications, not prehistoric species descriptions.

conditions.label: Earth
conditions.summary: The previous physical, etheric and astral germinal achievements are recapitulated; the independent human I enters a newly mineralized and sensory world, giving rise to objective awareness and a new moral task.
conditions.consciousness: Object consciousness and independent self-consciousness: external spatial objects and reflective thinking become salient.
conditions.human_organization: Physical body in a fourth condition of maturation, etheric in third, astral in second, and I at its beginning; later conscious transformation of these members is the task.
conditions.elements: The fully developed solid/mineral condition emerges alongside inherited warmth, air and water.
agencies: Spirits of Form / Exusiai: Earth-related conditions of the I in the broader Steiner corpus
Christ impulse: the transformation of inherited wisdom toward love
Earlier hierarchies: not replaced; their work remains embedded in the human members

milestones.heading: The I enters three earlier bodies
milestones.finding: Steiner explains the transition to Earth by locating an earlier physical, life and astral constitution before the human I began to work within it.

milestones.heading: Different ages of the four members
milestones.finding: The physical germ is called oldest; the I is the youngest, rather than the only spiritually significant member.

milestones.heading: Outer objects and inward thought
milestones.finding: The terrestrial waking condition differentiates the outward object world from inward concepts, memory and the sense of self.

milestones.heading: Earth's wisdom becomes love
milestones.finding: The inherited wisdom of Saturn, Sun and Moon is to be taken inward through the I and transformed into love.

pointers.passage_cue: GA 13 VI concluding discussion of the Cosmos of Wisdom and Cosmos of Love

milestones.heading: Continuity with future Jupiter
milestones.finding: Earth's acquisitions are carried through a later cosmic interval and participate in the next condition rather than being discarded.

milestones.heading: Distinct Earth subepochs
milestones.finding: Polar, Hyperborean, Lemurian, Atlantean, post-Atlantean and two projected future great epochs belong inside Earth; they are not separate cosmic embodiments.

cautions: The claim that astral disturbances cause illness is Steiner's speculation, not a medical explanation.
Do not equate development of the I with ordinary personal egotism.
Future cultural periods and Earth-wide cosmic stages must remain distinct levels.

conditions.label: Future Jupiter
conditions.summary: Steiner projects a later planetary condition arising through the metamorphosis of Earth after world-rest, integrating its new achievements with what was prepared in Old Moon.
conditions.consciousness: Self-conscious imaginative or image consciousness: the independent I persists while perceptive images of supersensible reality become accessible.
conditions.human_organization: Human spiritual capacities are described as transformed; contemporary mineral forms cease as such, with plant-like forces the lowest kingdom in his account.
conditions.elements: Not the current astronomical Jupiter; the account explicitly rejects a direct projection of today's physical material into that condition.
agencies: Spiritual inheritance of Old Moon and Earth conditions; no exclusive one-to-one creator claimed here
Human freedom, moral evolution and future assistance to other beings

milestones.heading: Earth and Old Moon inheritances unite
milestones.finding: Jupiter is described as future form shaped both by Old Moon preparation and by what human beings accomplish on Earth.

milestones.heading: Self-conscious image-awareness
milestones.finding: Steiner distinguishes Jupiter's controlled images from the older Moon's involuntary dream pictures.

milestones.heading: Recapitulation before the new stage
milestones.finding: GA 11 says the prior conditions are repeated before specifically Jupiter consciousness becomes established.

milestones.heading: Transformation of kingdoms
milestones.finding: Steiner predicts the end of a separately existing mineral kingdom, with a different plant-like kingdom lowest.

milestones.heading: Spiritual responsibility
milestones.finding: The account explicitly makes the development and help of other, less advanced humanity part of the new condition.

cautions: No numerical date or measured duration is given for Future Jupiter.
The source's moral grouping is not valid for judging contemporary communities or individuals.

conditions.label: Future Venus
conditions.summary: Steiner presents Future Venus as the higher transformation following Jupiter, with additional changes in the kingdoms and a projected consciousness of Inspiration or spiritually creative agency.
conditions.consciousness: The GA 104 lecture calls Venus consciousness Inspiration; GA 11 also emphasizes a higher self-conscious creative or object-forming relation. These are complementary formulations, but exact equivalence remains a textual comparison task.
conditions.human_organization: The plant kingdom no longer remains a separate lowest kingdom in GA 13; the source speaks of a changed animal kingdom and differentiated human possibilities.
conditions.elements: A symbolic name for a future cosmic embodiment, not the physical planet Venus.
agencies: No single hierarchy is exclusively named as Venus's creator in the checked passages
The human soul and creative spiritual agency have become more directly active

milestones.heading: Transformation after Jupiter
milestones.finding: Steiner says the old Sun-related spiritual sphere and Jupiter stage participate in a further Venus metamorphosis.

milestones.heading: The inspired state
milestones.finding: GA 104 describes consciousness of Inspiration as awareness of the inward nature of beings, expressed through spiritual tone.

milestones.heading: Creative rather than merely receptive knowing
milestones.finding: GA 11 contrasts Jupiter's conscious image-perception with a subsequent condition in which the soul actively creates.

milestones.heading: Altered hierarchy of kingdoms
milestones.finding: GA 13 says the plant kingdom also ceases to be lowest; the changed animal kingdom takes that role.

milestones.heading: The 'irreclaimable Moon' motif
milestones.finding: Steiner predicts a separate sphere for beings resisting development; the text supplies no verifiable astronomical forecast.

cautions: The account's 'irreclaimable moon' is a future esoteric motif, not today's Moon.
The GA 11 and GA 104 descriptions should not be silently blended into a modern science of mind.

conditions.label: Future Vulcan
conditions.position: 7 of 7 — most remote named planetary embodiment
conditions.summary: The seventh named planetary condition follows Venus; Steiner describes it as a spiritualized culmination, and places explicit limits on how much its detailed conditions can be stated.
conditions.consciousness: The GA 104 lecture calls this seventh state Intuition: participation in the being of what is known, without loss of individuality.
conditions.human_organization: The source does not offer enough detail for a reliable organ-by-organ or anatomical future forecast; future human life is described as profoundly spiritualized.
conditions.elements: No identification with a present Solar System object or a dated astronomical event.
agencies: No sole agency is securely assigned in the checked passages
The individual's participation in spiritual reality is central to the described consciousness

milestones.heading: Correspondence with Old Saturn
milestones.finding: Steiner compares Vulcan's relation to Saturn with Venus to Sun and Jupiter to Moon.

milestones.heading: Intuitive consciousness
milestones.finding: GA 104 describes a state of knowing through inward participation in the beings observed.

milestones.heading: Individuality persists
milestones.finding: The lecture explicitly says that individuality remains during this intimate participation.

milestones.heading: Consciously limited account
milestones.finding: GA 13 explicitly declines to provide a detailed description of life on Vulcan.

cautions: No dated sequence of Vulcan organs, nations, or physical geography is justified by these passages.
Preserve the explicit source limitations rather than inventing seven detailed Vulcan phases.
